critique: The black background and yellow-to-orange/red fire coloring are appropriate, but both frames remain a compact symmetric particle burst. Frame 4 expands evenly in all directions from a fixed bright center, reading as sparks from an explosion rather than a rocket moving on a single axis with a dense tapered flame trail. The particles are also mostly tiny round dots, with no substantial connected fire plume.

suggestions.why: Switch the emitter-direction mode away from the current radial/exploding behavior so emitted particles can follow one coherent rocket axis.
Greatly narrow directional spread so the fire forms a tapered plume instead of a circular spark field.
Add sustained forward particle velocity to establish visible directional travel and stretch the emission into a trail.
Reduce per-particle emission velocity variation so particles stay attached to the main forward-moving flame trail rather than dispersing as debris.
Make the fire sprites large enough to merge into a readable flame plume rather than resolving primarily as isolated spark dots.
